events.headline: PRO-GOVERNMENT RALLY IN TEHRAN DEMANDS END TO US THREATS
events.detail: Hundreds of Iranians have rallied in Tehran to demand an end to US threats and the ongoing blockade of Iranian ports.

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TRUMP URGES TEHRAN TO GIVE UP; GHALIBAF MOCKS US STRATEGY
events.detail: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf ridicules US's economic pressure campaign as oil prices surge and Hormuz standoff continues.

events.headline: ISRAELI FORCES RAID GLOBAL SUMUD FLOTILLA BOATS IN INTERNATIONAL WATERS
events.detail: Seven out of 58 vessels were captured by Israel near Crete, as flotilla aims to deliver aid to Gaza under blockade.

events.headline: TRUMP VOWS TO MAINTAIN IRAN BLOCKADE, TEHRAN THREATENS ‘PRACTICAL’ ACTION
events.detail: US president says Washington's naval siege on Iranian ports is 'more effective than the bombing' as oil price soars.

events.headline: ESTADOS UNIDOS SE PREPARA PARA UN BLOQUEO LARGO DE ORMUZ
events.detail: “Es más efectivo que los bombardeos”, ha sostenido Trump, tras cumplirse dos meses desde el inicio de la guerra

events.headline: LOS PIRATAS SOMALÍES RESURGEN A LA SOMBRA DE LAS CRISIS EN EL GOLFO Y EL MAR ROJ
events.detail: En los últimos días se han producido varios ataques contra embarcaciones que navegaban frente a la costa de Somalia, incluidos cuatro secuestros, que han encendido las alarmas
